member.name: T:Microsoft365DSC.Connection.ConnectionHelper
member.summary: Provides methods for determining the most secure authentication type supported by Microsoft365DSC resources.

member.name: M:Microsoft365DSC.Connection.ConnectionHelper.GetComponentsWithMostSecureAuthenticationType(System.String,System.String[],System.String[])
member.summary: Gets all resources that support the specified authentication method and determines the most secure authentication method supported by each resource.
member.param: The path to the DSCResources folder containing the .psm1 resource modules.

The authentication methods to evaluate, in order of preference: ApplicationWithSecret, CertificateThumbprint, CertificatePath, Credentials, CredentialsWithTenantId, CredentialsWithApplicationId, ManagedIdentity, AccessTokens.
The resource names to evaluate (without MSFT_ prefix and .psm1 extension).
member.returns: A list of Hashtable objects, each containing 'Resource' (string) and 'AuthMethod' (string).

member.name: M:Microsoft365DSC.Connection.ConnectionHelper.DetermineMostSecureAuthMethod(System.Collections.Generic.HashSet{System.String},System.Collections.Generic.HashSet{System.String},System.String)
member.summary: Determines the most secure authentication method for a resource based on the authentication methods requested and the parameters the resource supports. The priority order matches the original PowerShell elseif chain.
